name: seamtrail
description: SeamTrail, your team's shared memory, in Claude Code: the project's context (decisions, drift, your tickets) at chat start, and a reminder at turn end to save what was decided.

seamtrail_token.title: SeamTrail key
seamtrail_token.description: Make one in SeamTrail: Settings → Agents · MCP connector → Make a key. It works as you; remove it there any time.

seamtrail_url.title: SeamTrail address
seamtrail_url.description: Leave it as it is, unless your company runs its own SeamTrail.
